segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: אֵין צָרִין עַל עֲיָירוֹת שֶׁל גּוֹיִם פָּחוֹת מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים קוֹדֶם לַשַּׁבָּת. וְאִם הִתְחִילוּ — אֵין מַפְסִיקִין. וְכֵן הָיָה שַׁמַּאי אוֹמֵר: ״עַד רִדְתָּהּ״, אֲפִילּוּ בְּשַׁבָּת.
segments.en: «The Sages taught» in a Tosefta: «One may not lay siege to cities of gentiles fewer than three days before Shabbat,» to avoid the need to desecrate Shabbat in establishing the siege. «And if they» already «began» establishing the siege fewer than three days before Shabbat, «they need not stop» all war-related actions even on Shabbat. «And so Shammai would say:» From that which is written: “And you should build a siege against the city that is waging war with you «until it falls”» (Deuteronomy 20:20), it is derived that the siege should be sustained “until it falls.” Consequently, the siege must continue «even on Shabbat.»
